title: Tracking House races for 2026 midterms | CNN Politics
text:
Source: CNN

Democrats havewon control of the House, but the strength of their majority is still being determined as several races remain unresolved.

Democrats currently lead in two more seats, one in North Carolina and one in Minnesota, while Republicans lead in another North Carolina race. Those three races are undergoing recounts amid close vote margins.

There are also two races in Louisiana — the5th Districtand6th District— that will be decided in the state’s December 12 runoff.

Below are the House races where CNN has yet to project a winner, and races that were projected within the last hour. Follow along as results come in.

In North Carolina, both races are in the middle of machine recounts, which are expected to wrap up by early next week. It’s possible that the losing candidates in those contests could request a hand recount within 24 hours after the machine recount concludes. In Minnesota, a recount is expected to take place the week of November 30.
